title: Elixir of Life
description: A woman in a white and purple sari with three visible faces stands beside a blue-draped table, her hand extended toward a glowing green bottle labeled 'Elixir of Life'. The bottle is topped with a mechanical, insect-like creature, while a crystal ball containing a red planet sits nearby against a cosmic background of stars, galaxies, and geometric patterns.
prompt: A three-faced woman wearing a traditional white and purple sari with intricate borders stands with her hand extended toward a glowing green glass bottle labeled 'Elixir of Life' that emits light. The bottle is topped with a mechanical steampunk insect creature with large eyes. On the blue-clothed table beside it is a crystal ball containing a red planet. The background is a split cosmic scene with geometric constellations on the left and swirling galaxies, stars, and mountains on the right, in a detailed surreal illustrative style.
